summary: Require a distinct non-superuser/non-BYPASSRLS app role for the env-gated SQLx live PostgreSQL RLS probe.
claim_boundary: This slice hardens the existing generic live RLS probe so setup/DDL uses OYA_BACKBONE_POSTGRES_URL and tenant-runtime reads/writes use a separate OYA_BACKBONE_POSTGRES_APP_URL. The harness refuses runtime roles that are PostgreSQL superusers, have BYPASSRLS, or match the setup/DDL role, grants only schema usage plus table SELECT/INSERT to the runtime role, runs tenant inserts and tenant/no-tenant visibility checks through the runtime app pool, and records app-role verification in the probe report. A disposable local PostgreSQL 16 run proved the generic probe with distinct setup and app roles. It does not claim Citus distribution/rebalance, workload migrations, backup/restore, production rollout, live Oyatie Cloud substrate, or production tenant data-plane SLOs.

source_basis.use: Official PostgreSQL row-security documentation for policy behavior, default-deny semantics, FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, and the rule that superusers and BYPASSRLS roles bypass RLS.

facets.F1_simplicity: The change keeps the harness in the existing SQLx adapter and adds a single runtime app URL, role check, grant helper, and report fields rather than introducing a new service, fixture framework, or local-only wrapper.
facets.F2_hyperscaler: A tenant-isolation probe that can be run against cloud or self-hosted Postgres must not use a bypassing role; separating setup and runtime roles makes future Oyatie Cloud tenant evidence less likely to overclaim false RLS isolation.
facets.F3_adversarial: TDD started with compile failures for the missing app URL env var, MissingAppDatabaseUrl error, app connection config, quoted role grant helper, and app-role report fields. Tests now reject superuser runtime roles, BYPASSRLS runtime roles, and setup-role reuse before isolation can be claimed.
facets.F4_api_contract: Existing SqlxPostgresBatchExecutor APIs remain unchanged. LivePostgresRlsHarnessConfig adds app_database_url, from_env_map requires OYA_BACKBONE_POSTGRES_APP_URL when enabled, and LivePostgresRlsProbeReport adds app-role metadata only.
facets.F5_quality: Focused SQLx adapter unit tests, cargo check, clippy with -D warnings, fmt, and an env-gated disposable PostgreSQL 16 run passed before evidence recording.
facets.F6_operations: Operators now provide setup/admin and app/runtime DSNs separately. The harness validates runtime role safety, validates setup/app role distinctness, grants only required probe privileges, runs app-path DML/SELECT checks through the runtime pool, and cleans up the probe schema through the setup pool.
facets.F7_security_privacy: No credentials, database URLs, production tenant data, or secrets are stored in code or evidence. Runtime role names and synthetic tenant row counts are internal-only probe metadata.
facets.F8_supply_chain: No new dependency is introduced; the slice only changes the existing SQLx adapter source plus task/evidence metadata.
facets.F9_testing: Unit coverage is 12 tests for env gating, URL validation, SQL shape, tenant-scope plan ordering, role quoting, RLS-bypass role rejection, and setup-role reuse rejection. A local disposable Postgres run exercised the async live probe with distinct setup/app roles and no Citus requirement.
facets.F10_ci_cd: The live test remains opt-in by environment variable and therefore does not require CI secrets by default. Existing CI package inclusion for the SQLx adapter continues to compile/test the disabled path.
facets.F11_observability: Probe reports now include app_role_checked and app_role_name alongside schema/table, tenant visibility counts, RLS policy check, and Citus check flag.
facets.F13_reversibility: The app-role guard is isolated to one adapter crate and task/evidence rows; reverting this slice restores the previous single-URL generic harness without changing workload domain/API/usecase crates.
